title: DuckDB Governance Decisions Read-Side Projection v1
projection_artifact: In-memory only (DuckDB convention). Optional JSON projection metadata written to derived_dir / governance_decisions_projection_v1.json.
queries_supported: recent_decisions: ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
query_governance_decisions(): arbitrary read-only SQL with parameterized queries
diagnostics_supported: corrupted_manifest_line: JSON decode failure, line number recorded
missing_shard: manifest references envelope not on disk
orphaned_shard: envelope file on disk with no manifest row
dependency_changes: None. DuckDB >=1.5.0 already in pyproject.toml. hashlib, json, pathlib all stdlib.
source_of_truth_guarantee: JSON shard files + manifest.jsonl remain canonical source-of-truth. DuckDB projection is derived from these artifacts. Projection can be deleted and rebuilt deterministically (counts match). manifest_sha256 recorded in every row for provenance.
duckdb_non_authority_guarantee: Projection declares mutation_authority: false, read_side_only: true, raw_payloads_exposed: false. Never writes to source artifacts. In-memory only — no persistent .duckdb file. Rebuildable by design.
postgres_implications: Governance decisions table (14 typed columns + 4 indexes) maps directly to PostgreSQL materialized view (P3). All columns are VARCHAR, matching Postgres TEXT type. Parameterized insert pattern is Postgres-compatible.
remaining_replay_gaps: No timestamp range query via createdAt (VARCHAR not TIMESTAMP) — DuckDB can CAST but indexes less effective
No cross-surface correlation via request_id (request_id not yet in manifest)
No evidence_persisted field (not yet on ReceiptDecision)
No paginated find_by_results in query_governance_decisions (returns all matches)
next_recommended_implementation_slice: P1: Cockpit governance evidence timeline widget — consume DuckDB projection output to display 'why blocked?', surface activity, and decision timeline.
completed_work: Built governance_decisions DuckDB projection from ReceiptStore manifest + sharded envelopes
Used parameterized queries (executemany with ? placeholders) for SQL injection safety
In-memory only per codebase convention (no persistent .duckdb file)
11-column table + 4 indexes matching projection design spec
3 pre-built SQL query views (recent_decisions, surface_status_summary, authority_tier_summary)
content-light by construction (no raw payloads in any projected column)
Declares mutation_authority: false, read_side_only: true, raw_payloads_exposed: false
source_manifest_sha256 recorded for every row for source-of-truth provenance
4 diagnostic conditions recorded (corrupted_manifest_line, missing_shard, orphaned_shard, missing_manifest)
Graceful degradation: no-source-data, duckdb_not_available, build_failed states
query_governance_decisions() helper for ad-hoc read-only SQL queries
Optional derived_dir JSON projection artifact output
intentionally_deferred_work: Timestamp type conversion (VARCHAR → TIMESTAMP with CAST)
request_id propagation to ReceiptEnvelope for cross-surface correlation
